# historia-creditos-rezagado, B: marks the cutscene played here at once (A's start is then ignored: 'is set here'), reads
# the steps, only watches while A plays it, and reads the steps again at the end (the target or later).
# Written by tools/harness/historias.py: change its table and run it again, do not edit by hand.
#! noload
#! start coop: test warp done
#! switches LICHII_COOP_STORY=1
#! timeout 1150
#! expect B coop: test flag HavePlayedEvent\.InsideGanonCastle_Dungeon_BossDie_2 \(0x[0-9a-f]{8}\) = 1 within after..flagged
#! expect B coop: story: STORY_EVENT start received from P\d \('InsideGanonCastle_Dungeon_BossDie_2' in FinalBattleField\): ignored, HavePlayedEvent\.InsideGanonCastle_Dungeon_BossDie_2 is set here within flagged..end
#! never B coop: story: STORY_EVENT start received from P\d \('InsideGanonCastle_Dungeon_BossDie_2' in FinalBattleField\): starting
#! never B coop: story: event running 'InsideGanonCastle_Dungeon_BossDie_2' as P\d asked
#! expect B coop: story: Step_Defeat_Ganon \S+ -> Complete within asked..end
#! expect B coop: test enum Step_Defeat_Ganon \(0x[0-9a-f]{8}\): find_type -?\d+, value Complete \(0x within played..end
mark start
warp FinalBattleField StartPos_Defeat_Ganon_InBattle adult
wait 1200               # the title screen
mark title
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 300
press A                 # loads the save, then the warp
wait 2400               # the save loads, then the warp lands (about 30 s)
mark after
flag HavePlayedEvent.InsideGanonCastle_Dungeon_BossDie_2 1
wait 30
flag HavePlayedEvent.InsideGanonCastle_Dungeon_BossDie_2 1   # twice: a queued write may miss the frame the game applies
mark flagged
enum Step_Defeat_Ganon
wait 570
mark asked
wait 34200       # only watches while A plays it
mark played
enum Step_Defeat_Ganon
wait 600
mark end
